title: [Bug] Terminal rendering corruption with fullscreen mode enabled in multiplexer environments
body:
**Bug Description**
ZelliJ Rendering Issue with Fullscreen Rendering enabled
When scrolling up, only a small part of the viewport gets re-rendered, and all text is garbled
Scrolling down works as expected
Note: ZelliJ is running inside a Ghostty terminal
Note2: ZelliJ is a terminal multiplexer, like tmux or gnu-screen

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: ghostty 1.3.1
- Multiplexer: ZelliJ 0.43.0
- Version: 2.1.92
- Feedback ID: 68727cad-cfe8-4115-b103-fb225143f470

**Errors**
author: jeroenev
